source_title: Moto Buds 2 Plus deal brings Bose-tuned buds under $100
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Amazon has cut the Moto Buds 2 Plus to $99, $50 off the $149.99 retail price. That’s a 34% discount relative to the RRP, and it makes Motorola’s newer premium earbuds a lot more tempting right now.
The Moto Buds 2 Plus sit above the standard Moto Buds 2 in Motorola’s lineup, so this deal gets you the more feature-packed option for under $100. Motorola positions them as its premium 2026 true-wireless model, first shown at MWC 2026 and later launched in the U.S. They’re tuned with Sound by Bose and use a hybrid driver setup that combines an 11mm dynamic driver with a smaller micro-planar or balanced-armature-style driver for more detailed sound.
There’s more here than just audio tuning. The Moto Buds 2 Plus include dynamic ANC, dual-device multipoint, customizable touch controls, and an Audio Share mode that lets two pairs listen from one compatible phone. Battery life is rated at up to about 9 hours on the earbuds, with extra charge available from the case. Motorola also describes AI-assisted call and noise features, voice-assistant controls, and Hi-Res-style audio positioning in its lineup.
At their usual price, the Buds 2 Plus are aimed at the upper-mid-range earbuds crowd. At $99 on Amazon, they land in a much more appealing spot for anyone who wants stronger sound tuning and a longer list of extras without paying full price.
